description: A test class for DelinquencyWritePlatformService related to range change events in the Fineract project. Contains tests verifying the behavior of applying delinquency tags, raising events, and handling delinquency range changes for loans and installments.

classes.name: DelinquencyWritePlatformServiceRangeChangeEventTest
classes.description: A JUnit test suite verifying the behavior of delinquency range change events logic within the Fineract delinquency management module.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithDelinquencyBucketWhenRangeChangeThenEventIsRaised
methods.description: Test that verifies an event is raised when a delinquency range change occurs for a loan with a delinquency bucket.

methods.name: test_ApplyDelinquencyTagToLoan_ExecutesDelinquencyApplication_InTheRightOrder
methods.description: Test that delinquency application methods are called in the correct sequence for a loan with delinquency.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithDelinquencyBucketWhenNoRangeChangeThenNoEventIsRaised
methods.description: Test that no event is raised if there is no change in delinquency ranges.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithNoDelinquencyBucketThenNoEventIsRaised
methods.description: Test that no event is raised when the loan has no delinquency bucket.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithOverdueInstallmentAndEnableInstallmentThenDelinquencyRangeIsSetForInstallmentTest
methods.description: Test setting delinquency range for a loan installment when overdue and installment-level delinquency is enabled.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithOverdueInstallmentAndEnableInstallmentThenDelinquencyRangeChangesForInstallmentTest
methods.description: Test changing delinquency ranges for installments when overdue and installment-level delinquency is enabled.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWithOverdueInstallmentsAndEnableInstallmentThenDelinquencyRangeChangesEventWhenOneOfInstallmentIsOutOfDelinquencyTest
methods.description: Verify that when one installment falls out of delinquency, the range change event is triggered appropriately.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountEnableInstallmentLevelDelinquencyWhenLoanIsOutOfDelinquencyEventIsRaisedTest
methods.description: Test that an event is raised when a loan with installment-level delinquency enabled becomes delinquent.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWhenBackdatedPauseActionThenLoanDelinquencyPauseChangeBusinessEventIsRaisedTest
methods.description: Test that a pause action results in a business event being triggered, without a range change.

methods.name: givenLoanAccountWhenBackdatedPauseActionThenLoanDelinquencyRangeChangeBusinessEventIsRaisedIfPauseFlagChangeTest
methods.description: Verify that a range change event is produced when a pause action results in a change in delinquency range.
